data.text: I will sing of steadfast love and justice; to you, LORD, I will sing praise.
I will give heed to the blameless way. When will you come to me? I will walk with integrity of heart within my house.
I will set no worthless thing before my eyes. I hate the deeds of those who turn aside; they will not cling to me.
A perverse heart will be far from me; I will have nothing to do with evil.
Whoever secretly slanders his neighbor, I will destroy. I will not tolerate haughty eyes and an arrogant heart.
My eyes will be on the faithful of the land, that they may dwell with me; the one who walks in a blameless way will serve me.
data.titulo: My Eyes Will Be on the Faithful

data.text: No one who practices deceit will dwell in my house; no one who speaks lies will remain before my eyes.
Every morning I will destroy all the wicked of the land, cutting off all evildoers from the city of the LORD.
